title: Dibber 1 — repository settings (.dibber/config.json)
description: A repository's Dibber settings (SPEC.md R-DIB-14). Keys this schema does not name are allowed: they belong to a tool.

store.description: The store's folder, relative to the repository root, with no leading slash and no '..' segment.

prefix.description: The id prefix (R-DIB-4): upper-case letters and digits, starting with a letter, without the dash. Optional under ids: orchestrator, where the orchestrator holds it.

ids.description: Who makes a new ticket's id (R-DIB-4): numeric, the next free <PREFIX>-<n>; orchestrator, the orchestrator (today Baton), never Dibber. Default: orchestrator where .baton/baton.json is present, else numeric.
